protocol.input: Pinned WAV bytes via upstream mono/22050-Hz loader; no added normalization
protocol.time: Upstream note-event seconds rounded to nearest 96000-Hz sample; no fitted offset or grace
protocol.output: All upstream notes retained; MIDI 21-108 model range, no M3 range or polyphony filter
protocol.labels: Scoring only, loaded after inference; no relabeling or exclusion
protocol.comparison: Same-pitch overlap/touch union for BOTH detectors; distinct pitch occupancy, no lanes
protocol.strict_pitch_screen: Ordinary coverage gain >=5 percentage points; neither dataset loses any per-label pitch hold or longest hold, loses all-expected or exact pitch-set duration, increases wrong-pitch duration or unlabeled-gap pitch duration. This is a research screen, never live acceptance.
protocol.baseline_configuration: Saved collision-enabled CURRENT at block512, A4=440, trim=-9, sensitivity60, response75, maxpoly5, maxfret24. Independently configured from the upstream model defaults; not a controlled production-policy comparison.

report_only_diagnostics.per_label: Present-duration and longest-hold before/after/deltas for every label, including unchanged labels; retained on rejection.
report_only_diagnostics.union: Literal same-pitch occupancy union of all Basic Pitch and saved CURRENT outputs, without label-based selection, shifts or exclusions. Report complete pitch/label metrics, wrong/gap costs and added expected-pitch duration over each detector; never used for the research verdict or promotion.
